title: MAL RISK II: Risk of complications in outpatient treatment of imported Plasmodium falciparum malaria – an observational study in TropNet
summary:
The study aims to investigate which forms of treatment are safest for imported Plasmodium falciparum malaria.
All patients included in the study who are treated for this type of malaria at the study centers will be observed to determine which forms of treatment (outpatient or inpatient) were safest based on specific criteria.

interventions.name:
Patients with confirmed Plasmodium falciparum malaria undergoing outpatient or inpatient treatment are or may be included in the study. The form of treatment and therapy is based on the standards of the respective treating centre/clinic. There is no intervention on the part of the study.
